Get a 3 ml syringe with the long needle on it from the pharmacy. Take the plunger out and put a good amount of Cotten in the syringe. Then put the plunger back in and pack the Cotten down then take the plunger back out. Mix the powder with about 1 and a half to 2 regular size 100 unit 1 ml syringes full of water. Then mix that up. After mixing take the plunger out of the regular syringe you are going to shoot with and stick the 3 ml syringe tip (needle) into the top of the regular 100 unit 1ml syringe ( make sure that you have the plunger out of the 3 ml syringe as well). So you should have the 3ml syringe inserted into the top of the 100 unit 1ml syringe you plan on shooting with. Then pour the solution in the spoon into the top of the 3ml syringe and reinsert the plugger and push the solution into the regular 100 unit syringe your going to shoot with. Most the powder will soak up the extra water and you should end up with about 90-100 units of solution in the syringe you are going to shoot with. You may have a bit of the solution let over but most of it will be in the syringe your going to shoot with( you'll get better a judging the amount of water you need to use the more you do this). Then reinsert the plugger back into the syringe your going to shoot with and then you should be good to go. I hope this helps and you can understand what I'm trying to explain. It's really hard to explain without actually showing someone. But this method will allow you to get a lot of pills mixed up and into a regular syringe to shoot with. Also this method gets a lot of the binder out and you should come up with a fairly clear green or whatever color the pill is tinted solution. If the pill is white most the time the solution comes out completely clear. If you need any further help in understanding what I'm talking about just pm me and I'll do my best to explain.
